headline: Sale of city property at 3 Merrimack Street for a duplex, and draft changes to impact fee ordinance.
summary: A presentation by Councilor Todd and draft impact fee ordinance changes with a report to City Council are on the agenda. Brief updates cover C-PACER, Opportunity Zones 2.0 in Heights Census Tract #329, and the sale of 3 Merrimack Street in Penacook.
items: City Council referral on social districts rules and regulations
Presentation by Councilor Todd on impact fee ordinance amendments
Draft proposed impact fee ordinance amendments and report to City Council
C-PACER update, with a City Council hearing on December 14, 2026
Opportunity Zones 2.0: Heights Census Tract #329 selected for program
Sale of city property at 3 Merrimack Street (Penacook) for duplex redevelopment
location: City Council Chambers, 37 Green Street (2nd Floor), Concord NH 03301

ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEE (EDAC) 
MEETING AGENDA 
November 24, 2026 @ 5:00PM 
City Council Chambers - 37 Green Street (2nd Floor) –  
Concord NH 03301 
 
1. Welcome by Chair 
 
2. Adoption of October 27, 2026 Meeting Minutes 
 
3. Comments by the Mayor 
 
4. City Council Referrals 
a) Social Districts Rules and Regulations 
 
5. Impact Fee Ordinance Amendments Update 
a) Presentation by Councilor Todd 
b) Draft Proposed Ordinance Amendments and Report to City Council 
 
6. Brief Economic Development Updates 
a) C-PACER Update (City Council Hearing on December 14, 2026)  
b) Opportunity Zones 2.0: Heights Census Tract #329 Selected for Program  
c) Sale of City Property at 3 Merrimack Street (Penacook) for Redevelopment into Duplex 
(Former Penacook Branch Library)  
 
7. Other Business  
a) Future Meetings: January 26, 2027 
 
8. Adjourn  
 
All City of Concord public meetings are accessible for persons with disabilities.  Any person who feels that he or she 
may be unable to participate in a City of Concord public meeting due to a disability should, to the extent possible, call

For meetings held in the City Council Chambers, any person who is unable to access the upper level of the Council
